snake moves up the x=10 column (queued ArrowUp via GlobalKeyWatcher)
eats the food at (5,5): SCORE 1, MAGIC 2, RATE 12
queued D,R,U -> self-collision -> 'Game Over', dead cell at (6,5), switch off
RUN after death resets the game (reset()) and runs
reload while running: live board keeps moving, switch reflects running
console: no unexpected errors/warnings + no page errors
